gen-fs-expose-gf-noto-sans-nandinagari: Noto Sans Nandinagari keeps its openings generous at every weight, with short ascenders and a big lowercase body. Noto Sans Nandinagari under the compressed, tightly packed Expose should read smoothly for page after page, like a plain sans that never crowds you.
gen-fs-expose-gf-noto-sans-newa: Striking and refined, Expose packs its lines tight. Beneath it, Noto Sans Newa opens the mouth of its lowercase e and lifts its counters tall, a modern, easygoing foil to the compressed display type.
gen-fs-expose-gf-noto-sans-nushu: Noto Sans Nushu towers with its x-height, holding its terminals far back from the stroke body. Noto Sans Nushu then carries a long read with a modern, contemporary ease, while Expose stays compressed above it.
gen-fs-expose-gf-noto-sans-ogham: Noto Sans Ogham reads bold-looking because its lowercase bodies are so tall, with wide gaps in the e. Expose, compressed and refined, makes that sans feel even more contemporary.
gen-fs-expose-gf-noto-sans-ol-chiki: Noto Sans Ol Chiki forms words as solid blocks, not skylines. Its curve tails sit well back from the body, and Expose, with its compressed, striking cadence, makes a sharp sans-serif counterpart.
gen-fs-expose-gf-noto-sans-old-hungarian: Expose is compressed and refined, with barely any gap between x-height and caps, and it shines as a display voice. Noto Sans Old Hungarian does the opposite job, keeping its tall a, e and s open even at tiny sizes as a friendly sans-serif.
gen-fs-expose-gf-noto-sans-old-italic: Noto Sans Old Italic hardly separates x-height from cap height. Expose shares that tight stature, and both keep a compressed, contemporary look, with the sans holding its curve endings well apart.
gen-fs-expose-gf-noto-sans-old-north-ara: Dense, tall and tightly packed. Expose's compressed cadence leads, while Noto Sans Old North Arabian lays a lowercase band whose terminals point outward like tongs, and its sans-serif text reads steadily, approachable over a long stretch.
gen-fs-expose-gf-noto-sans-old-permic: Expose barely lets x-height and caps part ways. That compressed, refined display voice makes a strong foil for Noto Sans Old Permic, a plain sans whose rounded forms stay open and whose lowercase nearly matches the capitals.
gen-fs-expose-gf-noto-sans-old-sogdian: Expose is striking and refined, packed into a compressed cadence with very little pause. Noto Sans Old Sogdian follows with a tall x-height nearly reaching cap height, and its wide-mouthed sans letters keep a long passage crisp and clean.
